label: LSM303 Compass Logger
info: Reads the accelerometer, the magnetometer and the compass heading from an LSM303 every 500 ms. A function node computes the acceleration magnitude √(x²+y²+z²) and the magnetic field magnitude √(x²+y²+z²), so the total vector stays near 1 g and near the Earth's field strength while the static components shift between the axes as the board is turned. The heading in the payload comes from the driver's tilt-compensated compass algorithm. Demonstrates e-compass orientation sensing: rotate the board and watch the heading track the change while the magnitudes stay constant. Adjust the I²C bus number in the device config node to match the wiring.

name: magnitudes
